title: AstraDeFi
tagline: 🚀 Introducing AstraDeFi: The future of decentralized finance! Dive into seamless liquidity pools, staking, and lending with cutting-edge AI and real-time data from Goldsky. Powered by Mode's low-fee Layer 2, AstraDeFi offers an unparalleled DeFi experience.
description:
AstraDeFi provides a powerful staking feature, allowing users to lock their tokens and earn staking rewards without sacrificing liquidity. This ensures that users can continue to earn while still having the flexibility to manage their assets as needed. The platform’s staking mechanism is built to maximize returns while maintaining the security and integrity of user assets.

In addition to staking, AstraDeFi enables users to provide liquidity to Automated Market Maker (AMM) pools. By contributing to these pools, users not only earn a share of transaction fees but also enhance the overall liquidity of the platform, facilitating smoother and more efficient trading for everyone involved. The AMM pools within AstraDeFi are optimized for low slippage and high liquidity, ensuring that trades are executed quickly and fairly.

AstraDeFi also features a swap functionality, allowing users to effortlessly exchange tokens within the platform. With an intuitive interface and minimal transaction costs, AstraDeFi ensures that users can execute trades seamlessly, making it easier than ever to participate in the DeFi ecosystem.

Moreover, AstraDeFi includes advanced analytics tools that provide users with deep insights into their investments and the broader market. These tools help users make informed decisions by offering real-time data on liquidity, trading volumes, and price movements, all within a single platform.

AstraDeFi stands out not only for its features but also for its integration with cutting-edge technologies from ETHGlobal partners like Mode, Base, Blockscout Optimism, and Goldsky. These partnerships bring additional layers of innovation, security, and scalability to the platform, ensuring that AstraDeFi remains at the forefront of the DeFi revolution.

In summary, AstraDeFi is a versatile and user-friendly DeFi platform that brings together staking, liquidity provision, AMM pools, and token swapping, all underpinned by powerful analytics. Whether you’re an experienced DeFi user or new to the space, AstraDeFi offers the tools and features needed to navigate and thrive in the decentralized financial world.
how_its_made:
Building AstraDeFi was a journey of integrating cutting-edge technologies and innovative design to create a robust and user-friendly decentralized finance platform. Here's a breakdown of the nitty-gritty details behind its development:

AstraDeFi’s frontend is built using Next.js and TypeScript to create a responsive and user-friendly interface. We integrated WalletConnect and Web3Modal for seamless wallet interactions, and GraphQL powers the data querying, ensuring fast and efficient data retrieval across the platform.

On the blockchain side, we utilized Solidity for developing smart contracts, deploying them on Mode and Base testnets to ensure scalability and low transaction costs. Hardhat was used for testing and deploying these contracts, providing a robust development environment.

For real-time data analytics, we deployed subgraphs on Goldsky to track key metrics such as TVL, volume, and event data. This setup ensures that AstraDeFi provides accurate and up-to-date information, empowering users with valuable insights into their investments.

Partnership Integrations:
We integrated several technologies from our ETHGlobal partners to enhance AstraDeFi’s capabilities:

Mode was used as the DeFi layer-2 solution, built on the OP Stack, to ensure seamless EVM compatibility and exceptionally low fees. This allowed AstraDeFi to operate efficiently, making it easier for developers and users to interact with the platform while maintaining a high level of performance and scalability.

Base provided the layer-2 scalability solutions, crucial for bringing the benefits of Ethereum to everyone. Base’s integration enabled faster and cheaper transactions, making AstraDeFi more accessible and ensuring a smooth user experience, even during periods of high network activity.

Goldsky was implemented for real-time Web3 data access and analytics, making it easy to process complex blockchain data with minimal maintenance. By using Goldsky’s subgraphs, AstraDeFi could efficiently handle data complexities like reorgs and RPC failures, providing users with reliable and up-to-date insights into their investments and market trends.

Blockscout was used as Block explorer to show all the transactions.
